date_note: 1News (25 November) says RNZ staff lost access to systems on Wednesday morning, 25 November.
geo_basis: the report names New Zealand's public broadcaster RNZ without a city; pin at the country's capital
title: RNZ says it is investigating what it understands to be a cyber breach, 1News reports
summary: 1News reports that RNZ is investigating what a spokesperson called "what we understand at this stage to be a cyber breach". According to RNZ staff, some people could not reach Wi-Fi, editorial systems or the VPN on Wednesday morning. The spokesperson said unusual activity in one of its systems was identified and contained, and the National Cyber Security Centre and other authorities have been notified.
plain: 1News reports New Zealand's RNZ is investigating a suspected cyber breach after staff lost access to some systems. RNZ says it contained unusual activity in one system and has told the NCSC.
exec: RNZ says it is investigating a suspected cyber breach, contained unusual activity in one system and notified authorities, 1News reports.

validation.note: Only 1News was read; RNZ's own statement is quoted there but its page was not read.

review.note: Compared quotes, Wednesday 25 Nov date, contained activity, NCSC notified against 1News
